sources.summary: Dezeen School Shows: a lamp crafted from minimally processed wood is among designs by participants of New Designers that will be displayed during the London Design Festival this year. Also included is a mirror framed with a distinctive ripple-like structure, and candle holders sculpted from coloured porcelain.
